page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g7 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server features 64 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 64 vCPUs. It is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance operates on a KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, placing the instance in the top 25% for multi-core CPU stress tests, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU evaluations. It also demonstrates strong capabilities in specialized tasks, including software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, image processing, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth read/write speeds fall within the average range. For database operations and static web serving throughput, the instance ranks in the top 25%, while Redis SET operations and medium-model LLM inference speeds remain average.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7.16xlarge offers high resource density and strong multi-threaded performance relative to its general-purpose hardware profile. However, the lack of local storage requires external block storage attachments, which may introduce latency and additional configuration overhead. The instance is highly suited for multi-threaded workloads, software compilation, static web serving, database operations, and small-scale LLM inference tasks.
